title: Prospective Holdout Validation Specification for Mesh-Aware Energy Criterion

residual_sign_convention.r_E_positive: Unexplained energy excess beyond predicted discretization sharpening (excess stiffness / history ratcheting)
residual_sign_convention.r_E_negative: Unexplained energy deficit below predicted discretization sharpening (spurious relaxation / healing / interpolation loss)
residual_sign_convention.r_E_zero: Exact balance between target energy and independently predicted mesh-sharpened energy

holdout_experiment.recommended_state: Increment 85 (post-initiation localized crack tip, u ~ 0.00195 mm)
holdout_experiment.donor_source: Authentic coarse C3 donor continued to Inc 85
holdout_experiment.independent_predictor: Variational energy functional integration using localized asymptotic crack-tip model or multi-mesh scaling extrapolation
